children: Knowledge Economic City Company (KEC) and Kaden Investment Company have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop a 2.5 billion Saudi riyal ($666.16 million) mixed-use project in Madinah.

The Multaqa Al Madinah 2 project, located in the first phase of the Multaqa Al Madinah development, will be funded through a real estate fund, the company said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.
The project, an extension of the first phase, spans nearly 92,043 square meters (sqm) and has an estimated total gross floor area of almost 229,117 sqm.

Based on the initial concept, the project is expected to comprise 1,527 residential units across three residential zones, plus commercial and office components with a net leasable area of approximately 31,108 sqm. In addition, the project will include clubs, recreational and service facilities and landscaping works for the central park adjacent to the project.
The residential component is expected to be sold, while the commercial and office components are likely to be leased until operations and occupancy stabilise, followed by an exit through a sale.
Kaden Investment will serve as the project's development manager.
KEC will own 75 percent of the fund, while Kaden Investment will hold the remaining stake. Capital Hill has been named as the fund manager.
The first phase of the Multaqa Al Madinah project includes the mall, Hilton hotel tower and Hilton-branded residences tower.
